answer_1.quote: Definition generation can be formulated as a conditioned sentence generation task-generating a coherent sentence to define the target jargon.

answer_2.quote: For generation, we follow Bevilacqua et al. (2020) and apply several automatic metrics, including BLEU (BL), ROUGE-L (R-L), METEOR (MT), and BERTScore (BS).

answer_4.quote: We also ask three human annotators (graduate students doing research on computational linguistics) to evaluate the output definitions with a 1-5 rating scale used in...: 1) completely wrong or self-definition; 2) correct topic with wrong information; 3) correct but incomplete; 4) small details missing; 5) correct.
answer_4.guideline: 1-5 rating scale: 1) completely wrong or self-definition; 2) correct topic with wrong information; 3) correct but incomplete; 4) small details missing; 5) correct.
